title: Selection consistency predicate
statement: For a Boolean list $q$, the selection predicate is true exactly when either the witness blocks at indices $4$ and $1$ are equal and those at indices $5$ and $3$ are equal, or the blocks at indices $4$ and $3$ are equal and those at indices $5$ and $2$ are equal.
